fact: A one-year UN-backed pilot digitalising birth registration began in 2024 in Masina, Kinshasa, and 27,814 children in five Tshangu communes obtained birth certificates in 2024; extension to all Kinshasa needs further resources.
title: Kinshasa : 27 814 actes de naissance enregistrés par rattrapage dans le district de la Tshangu en 2024
